guarding_till_1500.name: Lastdenn Guard
guarding_till_1500.comment: WARNING: phraseId 100 is used in 2 conv conditions.

text: Halt! The mayor of Lastdenn has ordered me to stop anyone from passing through the town's entrance until 15:00.
Only those with official business in or from Lastdenn may pass here before then.
I'm sorry sir, but I have my orders.
I'm sorry, sir, that's not how it works. Official business must be pre-approved by the mayor.
[GRAY](It's quite scandalous that the mayor would close this passage for profit like this, if you ask me...)

choices.text: [Diplomat 3] *Make a formal request in the name of the priest.*

text: Well... There aren't really. Our priest is publicly opposed to this closure. He says that anyone on a religious pilgrimage should be allowed to pass freely.
[GRAY](I think he does have a point there...)
Ahem. I'm sorry, sir, but the only other option I can think of is to go back or wait until 15:00.

choices.text: *All right, stand by and wait until 15:00.* [BLUE](Skip time)
[Diplomat 3] *Make a formal request in the name of the priest.*

text: Hmm... I suppose I can make an exception for our priest.
You may pass, but do not let word of this get out.
Wait... What?! Are you serious?
Guards! To me! I'm under attack!
Almost there...
I allowed you to pass. Please do not let word of this get out.
This is the city of Lastdenn.
Now that it's after 15:00, the city is open to everyone. Don't cause any disturbances.
[GRAY](The mayor's decision to close the city entrance until 15:00 is quite scandalous, if you ask me...)
I allowed you to pass. Anyway, it's after 15:00 now, so the city is open to everyone. But still, do not let word of my earlier exception get out.
Hey Zachary! What a boring day it was! Did anything worthwhile happen while you were standing guard here today?
Nah, nothing much. The mayor's closure of the city entrance until 15:00 made for a pretty slow day.
Yeah. Still, at least we got to stand in the sun for a bit.
Sure, beats being cooped up inside all day.
Hey Zachary! What a day it was! Did anything worthwhile happen while you were standing guard here today?
Oh yes, quite a bit actually. Have you heard about Father Santino?
Yes, I heard he was murdered! They say he was killed by someone possessed by a ghost! Can you believe that?
It's terrible. Poor Father Santino... He was such a bright light in these dark times.
Indeed. He was one of the few people who dared to stand up to the mayor's corrupt practices.
He will be sorely missed.
[GRAY](A ghost...? Why would they make up such a story...?)
This is the city of Lastdenn.
Don't cause any disturbances.
This is the city of Lastdenn.
Don't cause any disturbances.

choices.text: *Warn the guard for the murder on Santino!*

text: Murder? No way! Our priest is very much beloved. Nobody would ever want him dead.
I'm sorry sir, but this house is off limits.
We are investigating a crime that occurred here.
Let us through. Nothing to see here. Move along.
I'm sorry sir, but the mayor does not wish to see you right now.
Hang on a minute! I'm talking to Father Santino right now. And the mayor is not expecting you at all.
I'm sorry sir, upstairs is off limits.
This area is off limits for civilians.
There is nothing here for you to see now.
No boats are coming in or out of the docks.
This evening however, around 19:30, we expect a boat to arrive.
It seems the boat arrived a bit earlier than expected.
The sailor seems to be some sort of teacher. What does he teach?
There is nothing here for you to see.
No boats are coming in or out of the docks.
This evening however, around 19:30, we expect a boat to arrive.

choices.text: *Warn the guards for the murder on Santino!*

text: What? Murder? Who would want to kill our priest? He's such a kind soul.
